**Description**


CRA II \- Italia \- Home Based
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  

  

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  

  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

* Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close\-out visits (performed on\-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH\-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site\-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
* May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
* For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site\-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
* May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project\-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection  

Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.


The potential annual gross salary for this role will start at EUR 42,000 (a partire da)


Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
* US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

**Get to know Syneos Health**

  

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.


http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Additional Information**

  

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

**Summary**


Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA are responsible for overseeing and ensuring the integrity of clinical research studies by monitoring data and processes from a centralized location. This includes conducting remote monitoring of trial sites to verify compliance with regulatory requirements and clinical protocols. Utilizes data analytics and risk\-based monitoring techniques to identify potential issues and trends, ensuring that trials are conducted in accordance with established clinical practices. Collaborates with site teams to develop and implement tools, procedures, and processes that enhance quality monitoring and support the overall success of clinical trials. Impact and Contribution Individual contributors with responsibility in a professional or technical discipline or specialty, but may manage two or fewer employees. May direct the work of lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Established and productive individual contributor. May manage defined components of projects or processes within area of responsibility. Requires practical knowledge of a professional area, typically obtained through education combined with experience.

**Data Specialist, Italy**

***Location: Milan, Italy***

 **Position Overview**

 Due to Mindray’s success, we have an opportunity for a qualified operations expert to demonstrate innovation and skills as a **Data Specialist** within our ultra\-ambitious Italian team as we continue to disrupt the market!

  

We are looking for experienced Data Specialist, happy to develop, energized by a varied and fast\-paced environment. In return you will work with industry\-leading technology, backed up by stable double\-digit growth, an awesome (and modest) manager, and a creative and disruptive working environment.

  

**Your responsibilities:**

  

**DATA ANALYSIS AND REPORTING**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyze commercial and operational information to provide sales reports and data that support decision\-making by regional leaders, the management team, and the sales team.
* Prepare detailed reports that identify business risks, opportunities, variances, and trends, with clear organization and intuitive presentation.
* Analyze operational and commercial issues through comprehensive, structured reports.

* Monitor business performance indicators, identifying risks, variances, and improvement opportunities that directly affect the achievement of objectives.

**SALES PLANNING AND TARGET FOLLOW\-UP**

* Support the GM and regional leaders in developing, analyzing, and monitoring annual, quarterly, and monthly commercial objectives.

* Monitor progress toward achieving results against established objectives, providing management with timely alerts regarding potential risks or variances.

* Manage user requests, including profile creation, permission assignment, and access maintenance, ensuring that the platforms operate properly.
* Train the sales team in the use of tools, reports, and platforms, fostering an analytical mindset.
* Provide first\-level support to users experiencing operational issues, coordinating and escalating technical incidents to HQ for resolution when necessary.
* Identify opportunities to improve digital tools and processes and participate in automation, digitization, and optimization projects to increase operational efficiency.

**MASTER DATA MANAGEMENT AND INFORMATION QUALITY**

* Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and timely updating of master data, including customer, distributor, installation, and commercial records, while promoting best practices.
* Regularly verify installation data and work closely with the technical service team to improve data quality.
* Lead and conduct periodic master data audits to drive improvement actions.
* Implement and establish robust data quality controls to prevent duplicate records, inconsistencies, and errors in master data.

**TRAINING AND DEVELOPMENT**

* Design and deliver training programs for local and European teams on the use of corporate platforms, reports, and processes, fostering awareness of data\-driven decision\-making.
* Conduct onboarding training for all new employees joining the local operation.
* Report participation, training, and progressive tool\-adoption indicators to HQ.
* Promote the development of analytical capabilities, a culture of data quality, and a proper understanding of corporate policies and systems.
* Actively participate in regional and global training sessions, knowledge\-sharing activities, and the adoption of best practices.

**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND STANDARDIZATION**

* Actively participate in regional and global initiatives focused on standardizing corporate processes, policies, and practices.
* Identify improvement opportunities by proposing, leading, or implementing solutions and strategic projects aimed at optimizing operational efficiency and digital transformation.
* Collaborate closely with HQ and regional teams on projects that promote productivity and sustainable business growth.
* Ensure strict compliance with corporate guidelines related to data quality, commercial processes, and operational management.

**REGIONAL AND EXECUTIVE SUPPORT**

* Provide comprehensive analytical and operational support to the General Manager (GM), Operation manager, CSO and other regional leaders.
* Act as a liaison between HQ, local sales teams, and functional support areas, participating in strategic assignments and special projects assigned by headquarters.
* Support meetings and visits with distributors for joint performance reviews and commercial analysis when analytical support is required.
* Provide analytical support for critical regional decision\-making processes.
  

**What we are looking for:**

  

**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s Degree or above, major in Business, Finance, Statistics or Engineering is preferred..
* Preferred qualification: A degree in Biomedical Engineering or another healthcare\-related field, combined with knowledge, postgraduate studies, or a professional certificate in Business Intelligence (BI) or Data Analytics.

**Professional Experience**

* Two to four years of demonstrated experience in Sales Operations, Business Intelligence (BI), or Commercial Analytics roles.
* Industry experience: Previous experience in multinational companies is preferred, particularly in the Medical Devices or Pharmaceutical industry.

* Data Analysis and Visualization: Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for developing management and commercial dashboards.
* Corporate Systems: Hands\-on experience with robust CRM systems, such as MSP, DMS, Salesforce, or similar platforms, is required.

**Languages**

* Italian: Native speaker or Advanced

* Oral and written fluency is required to interact with HQ and regional teams, present and substantiate reports, and participate in training delivered directly by HQ.
  

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply now and help us drive the success of tomorrow’s healthcare!

title: Vendor & Third-Party Management Quality & Compliance Manager
description:
Milan, Italy \| Full time \| Home\-based \| R1568840


  
**Job Overview**
  

The position provides Quality Assurance support for Global Medical Affairs Vendor \& Third\-Party Management, primarily through the management of quality events, quality issues, deviations, and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), as well as audit support and audit readiness. The role also supports Research Collaboration (RC) due diligence and selected non\-vendor third\-party assessment activities and contributes to third\-party quality risk management, compliance, and continuous process improvement.

  

  

**Quality Events, CAPAs and Audit Readiness**
  

* Manage Quality Events (QEs), Quality Issues (QIs), deviations, and related investigations in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Act as Deviation Owner, as appropriate, and support CAPA definition, implementation, tracking, effectiveness assessment, and closure.
* Support internal and external audits, audit readiness activities, and the remediation of audit findings.
* Ensure quality records, supporting documentation, and evidence are complete, accurate, traceable, and inspection ready.
  

**V\&TPM Quality Risk Management and Compliance**
  

* Support third\-party governance and oversight activities from a quality and compliance perspective.
* Support and contribute to third\-party Quality Risk Assessments (QRAs) and ensure assessments are completed, documented, and maintained for relevant GMA activities, including non\-interventional studies (NIS), real\-world evidence and real\-world data (RWE/RWD) activities, Research Collaborations (RCs), and partnerships. Follow up on identified risks and associated mitigation actions, as appropriate.
* Identify, assess, and escalate potential risks arising from third\-party due diligence, qualification, and oversight activities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable SOPs, business guidance documents, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.
  

**Research Collaboration/non\-vendor Due Diligence and Assessment**
  

* Support Research Collaboration (RC) and other selected third\-party (non\-vendor) due diligence and assessment activities, as required.
* Ensure the quality, accuracy, and completeness of due diligence and assessment documentation in TPM systems and tools.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and third parties to obtain information and documentation required for due diligence and assessment activities.
* Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of TPM due diligence tools, including TPIAT (Third\-Party Impact \& Assessment Tool).
**Process Improvement, Training and Stakeholder Collaboration**


* Lead and/or contribute as a subject matter expert to the design, revision, implementation, and continuous improvement of GMA V\&TPM quality, compliance, governance processes, standards, procedures, and guidance documents.


* Support the development, revision, and implementation of relevant procedures, standards, and guidance documents.


* Provide V\&TPM quality and compliance expertise, guidance, and training to operational teams and stakeholders.


* Collaborate with ESP Quality Assurance, Medical QA, GMA Medical Governance \& Risk Management, Procurement, Vendor \& Partner Governance (VPG), and other relevant stakeholders to ensure effective oversight of third\-party activities.


**Requirements**


* Degree in a life science or healthcare\-related discipline
* Previous experience in Vendor \& Third\-Party Management, Quality Assurance, Compliance, or a similar role supporting clinical research or Medical Affairs activities.
* Clinical Trial/Medical Affairs experience in a pharmaceutical company or a Contract Research Organization (CRO) is required.
* Experience working with external suppliers, research partners, and cross\-functional stakeholders within a pharmaceutical company or CRO environment. Emphasis on business, experience with clinical/medical affairs processes and activities and associated external services, with excellent understanding of study management.
* Strong understanding of clinical and Medical Affairs processes, study management activities, and associated external services.
* Good knowledge of the regulatory requirements in Clinical Research and drug development:
* In\-depth knowledge of the international pharmaceutical product development process
* Experience with GxP requirements, quality management system including risk management and regulatory requirements from main Health Authorities.
* A broad understanding of main Health Authorities standards, including FDA and EMA requirements, as well as ICH regulations and guidelines.

**At Hy\-Vee our people are our strength. We promise “a helpful smile in every aisle” and those smiles can only come from a workforce that is fully engaged and committed to supporting our customers and each other.**  

  



**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Pharmacy Technician, Non\-Certified


**Department:** Pharmacy


**FLSA:** Hourly


**Revision Date:** 07/2026


**About Hy\-Vee**

At Hy\-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.


**The Role and Why It's Important**

Our Non\-Certified Pharmacy Technicians are working toward their national certification while gaining hands\-on experience supporting pharmacists in the preparation and distribution of prescription medications. In this role, you'll assist with prescription processing, insurance billing, inventory, and customer service, all while building the skills and knowledge needed to grow in your pharmacy career.


If you are detail\-oriented, eager to learn, and passionate about helping people, we'd love to have you on our team.


**What You'll Do**

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:


* Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and making every interaction a positive one
* Handle customer inquiries that do not require a pharmacist's expertise and judgment
* Accept new written prescription orders and telephoned refill requests at the discretion of the supervising pharmacist
* Contact doctor's offices to take or request refill prescriptions as needed
* Gather and maintain accurate patient information required to prepare prescriptions
* Assist pharmacists in preparing prescription drug products for dispensing
* Prepare and affix labels to prescription containers and prepare prescriptions to be mailed
* Prepare and submit insurance claims and assist with third\-party insurance billing and troubleshooting
* File prescriptions after they have been dispensed and report any medication errors to appropriate personnel
* Order, check in, and stock pharmacy supplies and log invoices as necessary
* Perform cash transactions accurately
* Administer vaccines as allowed by law, with required certification where applicable
* Maintain the cleanliness of the pharmacy and dispensing area
* Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information in accordance with HIPAA
* Adhere to all statutes and regulations pertaining to a pharmacy technician
* Work with co\-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment
* Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned
* Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy\-Vee policies and store guidelines
* Report to work when scheduled and on time

**Your Skills**

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:


* Apply logical and scientific thinking to solve problems involving both abstract and concrete variables
* Perform arithmetic, algebraic, and geometric calculations accurately
* Compose original correspondence, follow technical manuals, and evaluate technical data
* Counsel and advise customers and interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and team members
* Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient information

**Reporting Relationships**

**Accountable and Reports to:** Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Store Operations, and Perishables; Pharmacy Department Manager; Staff Pharmacists


**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* Working toward licensed technician certification through a certified national program required
* Previous experience as a pharmacy clerk preferred
* Vaccination certification required if administering vaccines, as required by law

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions
* Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations
* Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration
* Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

**Working Environment**

This is a fast\-paced role in a retail pharmacy where you will handle multiple tasks throughout your shift including filling prescriptions, answering the telephone, and assisting customers. There is occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents during compounding, including chemotherapy drugs. This pharmacy handles and prepares hazardous drugs; personnel of reproductive capability should be aware that exposure may cause acute and chronic effects, and that following all pharmacy policies and procedures is essential to minimizing risk. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.


The anticipated hourly starting wage for this position is $15\.50 to $19\.30 depending on experience.
For information on company benefits visit Benefits \| Hy\-Vee .


Are you ready to smile, apply today.


*Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.*

--------------

* Master’s Degree in Law;

title: Leadership & Executive Coach
description:
We are seeking an experienced, highly engaging **Leadership \& Executive Coach** to support the development of senior leaders, managers, and high\-potential talent within the organization. The successful candidate will combine strong executive coaching experience with expertise in **DISC behavioral styles, leadership development, and practical behavior change**.

  

Experience in other leadership models would be advantageous. In addition to providing coaching, they will act as a **subject matter expert and thought partner in the design and development of leadership sessions**, helping ensure that content is practical, relevant, engaging, and aligned to the needs of The Client's leaders.


We are looking for an experienced practitioner who can translate behavioral insight into meaningful changes in how leaders communicate, delegate, influence, give feedback, manage conflict, motivate others, and lead their teams.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Executive \& Leadership Coaching**

* Provide high\-quality, in\-person executive and leadership coaching to senior leaders, managers, and high\-potential executives.
* Build trusted relationships with leaders while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Observe leadership behaviors in real time and provide insightful, constructive feedback.
* Help leaders translate DISC and behavioral insights into practical changes in their day\-to\-day leadership.
* Support leaders in areas including communication, delegation, influence, feedback, conflict management, motivation, team dynamics, and leadership presence.
* Appropriately challenge senior leaders while creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, and accountability.
* Focus on sustainable behavioral change and measurable leadership impact rather than one\-off training outcomes.

**Leadership Development Subject Matter Expert**


The coach will also serve as a **subject matter expert (SME) and thought partner** in the design of leadership development sessions in partnership with the Transperfect project team.


Responsibilities may include:

* Advising on the design and structure of leadership development sessions.
* Helping translate leadership theory and DISC concepts into practical, relevant activities and learning experiences.
* Providing insight into the behavioral and leadership challenges faced by senior leaders in a manufacturing environment.
* Reviewing and refining session content, exercises, case studies, and coaching activities.
* Helping ensure that sessions are engaging, practical, and directly applicable to participants' day\-to\-day leadership responsibilities.
* Bringing current thinking, best practice, and real\-world executive coaching experience into program design.
* Working collaboratively with The Client’s stakeholders, trainers, and other subject matter experts.
* Adjusting content and approach based on participant needs, feedback, and observed leadership behaviors.

 **Ideal Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate will be an accomplished executive/leadership coach with significant experience working with **senior leaders, managers, and high\-potential executives**.

**Essential Experience**

* Proven executive and leadership coaching experience.
* Demonstrable track record of coaching senior leaders and executives.
* Strong understanding and practical application of DISC behavioral theory.
* Experience translating behavioral assessments into observable leadership behaviors and meaningful action.
* Ability to recognize behavioral patterns and connect them to individual and team impact.
* Evidence of sustained client outcomes and behavioral change.
* Experience contributing to or designing leadership development programs and sessions.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to engage credibly with senior business leaders.

**Desirable\- Manufacturing \& Business Experience**


Experience in a **manufacturing, industrial, engineering, or similarly operational environment** is highly desirable.


The ideal candidate will understand the leadership realities associated with areas such as:

* Operations
* Health \& safety
* Quality
* Supply chain
* Continuous improvement
* Operational performance
* Organizational change
* Conflict resolution


They should be able to connect leadership development and behavioural change to **real business and operational outcomes**.

**Personal \& Coaching Style**


The successful candidate will be:

* Highly emotionally intelligent, empathetic, and self\-aware.
* An exceptional listener with genuine curiosity.
* Highly observant and able to identify behavioral patterns in real time.
* Comfortable challenging senior executives in a direct but constructive manner.
* Energetic, motivational, and engaging.
* Warm and approachable, with a good sense of humor.
* Adaptable and able to build rapport quickly with different personalities and leadership levels.
* Confident facilitating groups as well as coaching individuals.
* Practical and commercially minded, with the ability to avoid overly theoretical approaches.

**Qualifications \& Accreditations**


Ideally, the candidate will hold:

* A recognized executive/leadership coaching qualification or accreditation.
* DISC certification and/or recognized DISC training experience.
* Membership of, or accreditation with, a recognized professional coaching body, such as ICF (PCC), EMCC Global (EIA), Marshall Goldsmith Stakeholder Centered Coaching (MGSCC), or the Center for Creative Leadership (CCL).
* Additional leadership, organizational psychology, behavioral science, facilitation, or relevant professional qualifications would be advantageous.

title: Global Study Lead - FSP EMEA
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**

### **The Opportunity**

  

We are seeking an experienced Global Study Lead (GSL) to provide strategic and operational leadership for complex global clinical studies.

  

This is a senior study leadership position with end\-to\-end accountability for clinical study delivery, from study initiation through to study close\-out and archiving. You will define the operational strategy, lead cross\-functional study teams, and ensure studies are delivered to the required timelines, quality, budget and regulatory standards.

  

As a key member of the Study Leadership Team, you will represent Clinical Operations and work closely with Clinical, Statistics and other cross\-functional partners to drive decisions, manage risk and ensure successful study delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the operational strategy and end\-to\-end delivery of one or more global clinical studies.
* Own study timelines, budget, quality, risks and key operational deliverables.
* Provide strategic leadership to global, cross\-functional study teams and drive timely decision\-making.
* Represent Clinical Operations within the Study Leadership Team and act as the senior escalation point for operational issues.
* Translate clinical development and asset strategy into clear study\-level operational plans.
* Lead proactive study risk identification, mitigation and issue resolution.
* Ensure robust feasibility, study planning and operational execution.
* Provide strategic operational input into protocols, informed consent forms and other key study documents.
* Oversee CROs and other external vendors, including vendor selection, performance management and escalation where deliverables are at risk.
* Ensure studies remain compliant with ICH\-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and inspection\-readiness requirements.
* Lead study financial planning, forecasting and budget management.
* Communicate study progress, risks, decisions and recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Champion innovative approaches to clinical trial delivery, including decentralised trial approaches, technology, automation and AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Clinical Operations.

### **About You**

  

You will be an accomplished clinical operations professional with significant experience leading complex global clinical studies within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

  

You will bring:

* A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in global clinical study delivery, ideally across multiple phases, indications and geographic regions.
* Proven experience holding end\-to\-end accountability for complex global clinical trials.
* Strong experience leading global cross\-functional teams within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of study timelines, budgets, risks, quality and operational strategy.
* Significant experience overseeing CROs and third\-party vendors, including performance management and issue resolution.
* In\-depth knowledge of ICH\-GCP, global regulatory requirements and clinical development processes.
* Strong project and financial management capabilities.
* The ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex, fast\-paced environments.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and conflict\-management skills.
* Experience proactively identifying and resolving risks that could impact clinical programmes.

### **Highly Desirable**

  

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Phase II and/or Phase III global clinical trials.
* Adaptive or other innovative trial designs.
* Decentralised clinical trials (DCTs).
* Platform, umbrella or basket studies.
* Technology\-enabled clinical trial delivery, automation or AI/ML.
* Working with investigators, external experts and regulatory authorities.
* Broad therapeutic\-area experience, combined with deep expertise in one or more indications.

### **What Success Looks Like**


The successful Global Study Lead will be able to set the vision for study delivery, translate strategy into execution and bring diverse stakeholders together around clear priorities. You will be comfortable making complex decisions autonomously, challenging constructively, escalating when required and empowering teams to deliver in demanding global clinical\-development environments.

title: Research Technician - SR TIGET
description:
The Institute. SR\-Tiget was created in 1996 as a joint venture between Fondazione Telethon and Ospedale


San Raffaele (OSR), with a mission to conduct cutting\-edge research on gene and cell therapy and translate


its results into therapeutic advances for genetic diseases. The Institute is located on the OSR campus, which


includes a large research hospital, a biomedical research center, a university, and several biotechnology


companies. Over the years, SR\-Tiget has made pioneering contributions to gene and cell therapy, with key


discoveries in vector design, gene transfer and gene\-editing strategies, stem cell biology, and the identity and


mechanisms of action of cells in innate and adaptive immune responses. SR\-Tiget has also built the resources


and framework to translate these advances into novel experimental therapies and has implemented several


successful gene therapy clinical trials, which have already treated \>160 patients and led to the filing and


approval of 3 novel advanced therapy medicines. SR\-Tiget comprises 19 Research Units, 5 Development


Cores, and 2 Clinical Units embedded within the San Raffaele Hospital. With a team of over 300 professionals


from more than 10 countries, the Institute continues to drive scientific innovation and deliver life\-changing


therapies to patients worldwide.

  

  

**Posizione:**
--------------

A Research Technician position is immediately available in the group led by Alessio Cantore at the San


Raffaele Telethon Institute for Gene Therapy (SR\-Tiget), Milan, Italy.


The position. We are looking for a highly motivated Research Technician with experience in mouse


experimentation, cell culture, and molecular biology to join an enthusiastic, dynamic research team


developing in vivo gene therapy for rare genetic diseases. The successful candidate will work in a


multidisciplinary, collaborative research environment with a strong emphasis on developing novel gene and


cell therapy strategies to treat genetic diseases.


Main tasks

* Mouse work (mice handling, in vivo treatments, organ isolation and analysis)
* Cell culture (cell lines, primary cells)
* Molecular biology, biochemistry (PCR, cloning, ELISA, western blots)
* Flow cytometry, histology
* Production of recombinant lentiviral vectors
* Training of new lab members

**Requisiti:**
--------------

Qualifications and skills

* Biomedical degree (Bachelor, Master, or Ph.D.) with at least 1 year of previous lab experience
* Mouse experience
* Cell culture and molecular biology experience
* High accuracy, reliability, precision
* High motivation to work in an international, fast\-paced environment
* Excellent organizational skills
* Friendly, collaborative, proactive mindset
* Good oral and written English skills

**Altre informazioni:**
-----------------------

We offer

* 1\-year renewable fixed\-term contract (assunzione a tempo determinato) with Fondazione Telethon
* Salary commensurate with qualifications and experience: 24\.000\-34\.000 euros gross annual (RAL)
* Opportunity to learn new cutting\-edge advanced techniques
* A dynamic environment and the chance to make an important contribution to the development of


innovative ATMPs


Please submit applications to Alessio Cantore (cantore.alessio@hsr.it), including a CV and the contact


information of 1 or 2 referents. We will begin evaluating applications and conducting interviews immediately


and continue until the position is filled.
